messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2: The billing API lives with the Atlas team. For the record, feature-flags is owned by Atlas.
- [2025-03-07] handover/2025-03-07-billing-api: Billing-api has a new home: the Ember team. Team Atlas kept it until today.
- [2025-07-03] handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction: Fixing an error in the 2025-06-09 handover: the new owner of billing-api is Atlas. Team Boreal was recorded by mistake and never held it.
- [2026-01-12] handover/2026-01-12-billing-api: Quick one: billing-api belongs to the Ember team starting today. Thanks to the Atlas team for running it until now.
- [2025-01-08] standup/atlas/2025-01-08: For the record, the ledger service is owned by the Atlas team.
- [2025-11-04] standup/atlas/2025-11-04: Reminder that the billing API depends on the ledger.
- [2025-09-30] standup/atlas/2025-09-30: Decision: billing-api will gate the new invoice flow behind feature-flags, because the rollout needs a per-tenant kill switch. The billing API now depends on the feature flag service. The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday.
- [2025-07-17] standup/atlas/2025-07-17: The ledger remains a Atlas service.
- [2025-06-09] handover/2025-06-09-billing-api: The Ember team handed billing-api to Boreal today; Oskar wrote up the handover doc for Lena Fischer.
- [2025-01-09] standup/atlas/2025-01-09-2: Dependency map update: billing-api needs Ledger (invoice postings).
- [2025-02-11] standup/atlas/2025-02-11: Reminder that the billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.
- [2025-12-25] standup/atlas/2025-12-25: Atlas saw that the reports pipeline's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it. Atlas has moved to the second floor.
- [2025-10-13] handover/2025-10-13-ledger: From today the pager for the ledger rings Cinder, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2026-04-16] standup/atlas/2026-04-16: The Atlas team saw that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-04-08] standup/atlas/2026-04-08: Reminder from the Atlas team: page Marcus for anything this cycle, not Priya. The Atlas team saw that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout; not their service, so they flagged it.
- [2026-03-11] standup/cinder/2026-03-11-2: The Cinder team noticed that billing-api's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners.
- [2025-11-11] standup/atlas/2025-11-11: Deploy freeze for the billing API: 2025-11-24 to 2025-12-02 (the peak season).
- [2026-04-01] handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer: From today the pager for the search indexer rings the Boreal team, not team Atlas. Ownership transferred.
- [2025-10-15] standup/atlas/2025-10-15: Team Atlas noticed that the image resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners.
- [2025-05-13] standup/atlas/2025-05-13: The Atlas team on-call swapped this morning. Priya carries the phone until the next rotation.
- [2025-12-19] handover/2025-12-19-catalog: Atlas is taking over the product catalog from the Cinder team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-12-01] standup/boreal/2025-12-01: Heads-up from Boreal: the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.
- [2025-01-06] standup/atlas/2025-01-06: The Atlas team this year is Priya Raman and Tomasz.
- [2025-11-24] handover/2025-11-24-event-bus: Atlas is taking over the event bus from Boreal, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-06-19] standup/atlas/2025-06-19: Rotation day for team Atlas: Priya hands the pager to Tomasz.
- [2025-05-20] handover/2025-05-20-search-indexer: Team Atlas is taking over search-indexer from team Cinder, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-04-02] standup/ember/2025-04-02: Changes to the billing API need a rollback plan attached to the pull request.
- [2025-03-28] standup/atlas/2025-03-28: Priya still has the Atlas pager.
- [2025-07-30] standup/atlas/2025-07-30: Team change: Tomasz leaves team Atlas and joins team Dune, effective today. On-call for Atlas passes from Tomasz to Priya with the move.
- [2025-11-26] handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer: The Atlas team is taking over the image resizer from the Ember team, effective today. Dashboards and alerts are being repointed.
- [2025-02-12] standup/atlas/2025-02-12: On-call rotation: Priya is primary for the Atlas team starting today; Tomasz is off rotation.
- [2025-04-03] standup/atlas/2025-04-03: Reminder from team Atlas: page Tomasz for anything this cycle, not Priya.
- [2026-06-04] standup/atlas/2026-06-04: Priya Raman has the Atlas pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus.

Question: Which team owned billing-api before Atlas took it over?

message.reasoning:
The question: "Which team owned billing-api before Atlas took it over?"

Current state: today is 2026-06-30. The latest handover: 2026-01-12: billing-api belongs to Ember team starting today, Atlas ran it until now. So Atlas took it over on 2026-01-12, from Ember.

But wait — there was a handover on 2025-03-07: billing-api has new home: Ember team, Atlas kept it until today. Then correction 2025-07-03: fixing error in 2025-06-09 handover: new owner is Atlas, Boreal was recorded by mistake. Then 2026-01-12: billing-api belongs to Ember starting today, Atlas ran it until now.

The question: "Which team owned billing-api before Atlas took it over?" The most recent handover where Atlas took it over is 2026-01-12, where Atlas ran it until now and Ember took over. Wait — that's Ember taking it from Atlas. Hmm, "before Atlas took it over" — the question asks which team owned billing-api before Atlas became owner.

Hmm, but in the 2026-01-12 entry, Ember is taking over FROM Atlas. So Atlas didn't "take over" then; Atlas gave it up. The earlier handovers: 2025-03-07: billing-api went to Ember from Atlas. 2025-07-03 correction: new owner of billing-api is Atlas (correcting 2025-06-09 which said Boreal). So Atlas took over billing-api... from Ember? Actually the correction says the new owner is Atlas, correcting that Boreal was recorded by mistake. The 2025-06-09 handover said Ember handed billing-api to Boreal. Correction: new owner is Atlas.

So per the correction, Atlas took over billing-api from... The chain: initially Atlas (2025-01-08), then Ember (2025-03-07), then correction says new owner is Atlas (2025-07-03). So before Atlas took it over (per the correction), the owner was Ember. Because the correction says Boreal never held it — so the team that had it before Atlas was Ember (the 2025-03-07 owner).

So the answer: Ember.

Alternatively, if the question refers to the most recent change (2026-01-12), Atlas gave it to Ember — that's not "Atlas took it over."

So the answer is Ember.
